name: Zhenjiang Dongfang Electric Heating Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhenjiang Dongfang Electric Heating Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, integration, and application of thermal management systems and new materials in China. The company offers oven electric heating, nickel welding boiler heater, microwave oven heater, washing machine electric heating, and steam boiler heaters, as well as electric heating elements for small household appliances. Its products are used in home appliances, automobiles, industry, and robotics, as well as optical communication and batteries.
